purpose: Select the earliest healthy full epoch before creating the separate fresh V1.7 common warmup.
initialization: fresh OpenAI CLIP only; historical adapter_10 is readiness reference only

training.precision: strict FP32; TF32 off; AMP off
training.dfg: attn/256/tau8/SS2D weight_residual with beta warmup010 to 0.10

evaluation.timing: post-training inference at saved epoch boundaries only

selection_rule: earliest full epoch that is non-floor-degenerate and near the epoch-10 historical readiness reference; candidate outcomes are not consulted
